Advertisement for Engagement of Research Staff
Applications are invited in the prescribed format from suitable candidates with backgrounds in
Management, Economics, Behavioral Sciences, and Quantitative Social Science for engagement as
research staff in the following positions under a purely time-bound ANRF (erstwhile SERB) Research
Project (2025–28) titled “Nudging to Address Over-The-Counter Drug Abuse: Promoting Responsible
Use through Pharmacy Platforms in India,” undertaken at the School of Business Studies, Central
University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Samba–181143.

Terms and Conditions
• This temporary engagement will be for a specific period and shall automatically stand terminated with the
completion/termination of the project, or earlier at the discretion of the Principal Investigators(s).
• The engagement will not entitle the candidates to any claim for regular employment in the University.
• Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email and called for interview (online/offline).
• Candidates called for interview will not be entitled to TA/DA.
• The decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.
• Tenure of the assignment for the post at S. No. 1 (JRF) shall initially be for 1 years (12 Months), and may be extended further
based on performance and project requirements, up to the sanctioned duration of the project.
• The application form complete in all respects along with CV, self-attested copies of qualification certificates, and a recent
passport-size photograph should reach the office of the undersigned, School of Business Studies, Central University of Jammu,
Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), District Samba–181143, J&K, either as hard copy or by email at gowhar.hrm@cujammu.ac.in|
anjali.hrm@cujammu.ac.in on or before [15/08/2026]. The application form can be downloaded from the University website
www.cujammu.ac.in.
• The competent authority reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacancies notified in this advertisement.
• Preference will be given to candidates having prior experience of working in research projects.
